## Get FASTQ Files for GEO samples
```{bash get_data_dl_geo}
#| eval: false
n_geo_samples=$(grep -v geo_id misc/validation_geo_metadata.txt | wc -l)

n_geo_samples=$((n_geo_samples - 1))

sbatch --array=0-${n_geo_samples}%10 sbatchCmds/get_geo_fastqs.sh
```

## Next, run cellranger count on the raw data from GEO
```{bash get_data_count_geo}
#| dependson: get_data_dl_geo
#| eval: false
n_samples=($( \
    cut -f 3,8 misc/validation_geo_metadata.tsv \
    | uniq \
    | grep -v sample_id \
    | wc -l \
))

# since the array will start at zero
n_samples=$((n_samples - 1))

sbatch --array=0-${n_samples} sbatchCmds/count_geo.sh
```

## Delete the GEO fastqs to save space
```{bash get_data_rm_geo_fq}
#| dependson: get_data_count_geo
#| eval: false
rm input/othertumors/fastqs/G*/*.fastq.gz
```

## Make up the fastqs for the data from our lab
```{bash get_data_roberts_fastqs}

sbatch sbatchCmds/make_Roberts_fastqs.sh
```

## Run cellranger count on these samples
These are aligned to the new reference with gfp/rfp
```{bash get_data_roberts_count}

```
